title: 2 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 15
description: Ten questions on 2 Samuel 15: Absalom steals the hearts of Israel and David flees from Jerusalem.

questions.text: How many men did Absalom prepare to run before him?
questions.explanation: Absalom prepared a chariot and horses for himself, and fifty men to run before him.

questions.text: What was the result of Absalom's actions at the gate?
questions.explanation: Absalom did this to all Israel who came to the king for judgment, so Absalom stole the hearts of the men of Israel.

answers.text: He stole the hearts of the men of Israel
He was made a judge by David
He was driven out of the city
He gained the favor of the priests only

questions.text: Where did Absalom ask to go to pay his vow to Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Absalom said, "Please let me go and pay my vow, which I have vowed to Yahweh, in Hebron."

questions.text: What signal were the people to wait for before saying that Absalom was king?
questions.explanation: Absalom sent spies saying, "As soon as you hear the sound of the trumpet, then you shall say, 'Absalom is king in Hebron!'"

questions.text: Whom did the king leave to keep the house when he went out?
questions.explanation: The king left ten women, who were concubines, to keep the house.

answers.text: Joab and his mighty men of war
His son Solomon and his mother

questions.text: Who told David, "Whether for death or for life, your servant will be there also"?
questions.explanation: Ittai the Gittite answered the king that wherever the king is, whether for death or for life, he will be there also.

questions.text: What did David tell Zadok to carry back into the city?
questions.explanation: The king said to Zadok, "Carry God's ark back into the city."

questions.text: How did David go up the ascent of the Mount of Olives?
questions.explanation: David went up weeping, with his head covered, and went barefoot.

answers.text: Carrying a sword in his hand
Weeping, with his head covered and barefoot

questions.text: What did David pray when he heard that Ahithophel was among the conspirators?
questions.explanation: David said, "Yahweh, please turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness."

answers.text: That Yahweh would strike Ahithophel down that day
That Ahithophel would come back and serve him
That Yahweh would turn Ahithophel's counsel into foolishness
That Absalom would be caught in his own plans

questions.text: Who came to meet David at the top with his tunic torn and earth on his head?
questions.explanation: Hushai the Archite came to meet him with his tunic torn and earth on his head.
